description: Works out Etsy's fees on one sale, line by line: the $0.20 listing fee, the 6.5% transaction fee, the 3% + $0.25 payment processing fee (also charged on sales tax), the 2.5% currency conversion when it applies, and the Offsite Ads fee (12% or 15%, at most $100) when the sale came from an Offsite Ad. It fits a seller who asks what Etsy takes from a sale, or what they keep from it before costs. Takes the item price and shipping charged; optionally the sales tax rate, whether it was an Offsite Ads sale and at which rate, and a currency mismatch. Returns each fee, the total, its share of the order and what's left, in US dollars, with the dated Etsy rules and their sources. Free, no sign-in. Takes numbers only; nothing is stored.

currencyMismatch.description: True when the listing's currency differs from the payment account's (Etsy adds 2.5%). Default false.

itemPrice.description: The item price on this sale, US dollars, before shipping.

offsiteAds.description: Did this sale come from an Offsite Ad? none, or the rate the shop pays: 12-percent (the shop has sold $10,000 or more in any 12 months) or 15-percent (under $10,000). Default none; off is taken as none.

salesTaxRate.description: The sales tax rate the buyer paid, as a fraction (0.07 is 7%). Etsy charges its 3% processing fee on the tax too. Default 0.

shippingCharged.description: What the buyer paid for shipping, US dollars (0 if free).

name: sellerprofit_etsy_fees

afterFees.description: Order total minus every fee: what's left before materials, packaging, the label and ads.

etsyTotal.description: Every Etsy fee above, before Offsite Ads.

link.description: Opens the matching page on sellerprofitdoctor.com. Carries none of the figures sent.

capApplied.description: True when Etsy's $100 cap per order cut the fee.

orderTotal.description: Item + shipping the buyer paid, before tax, US dollars.

rates.description: Which rules the numbers use, as of when, and where they come from.

asOf.description: The day the platform's fee table was last checked against its sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

estimatesLine.description: Amazon only: which rates are third-party estimates (FBA, storage, returns and the rest sit behind the Seller Central login). Say so when citing them.

recheckBy.description: The day the table is due for its next check.

title: Fees on one Etsy sale
